title: T007 merge accepted with bounded Docker runtime-proof follow-up
summary: Mark explicitly authorized checking and merging T007 before T008. Static proof passes; Docker container health remains UNKNOWN and must be revalidated by T008 CI.

claims.text: Mark explicitly approved T007 checkbox completion and PR #24 merge before T008 dispatch.
T007 static Compose, network, port, healthcheck, shell and fail-closed proof passes.
PostgreSQL, S3Mock and mock-oauth2-server runtime health remains UNKNOWN because the current runner has no Docker CLI.
T008 CI must revalidate the T007 dependency stack before its runtime proof is treated as complete.

decision.context: The user explicitly requested T007 checkbox completion and merge before T008, while the current runner cannot execute Docker.
decision.chosen: Accept T007 for merge with a bounded runtime-proof follow-up owned by T008 CI.
alternatives: Keep T007 blocked until an external Docker runner is available
tradeoffs: Runtime health remains unverified until CI
decision.invalidation: If T008 CI cannot start or health-check the three services, reopen T007 and block dependent integration work.
